svg.title: Tool schemas can consume the context before the agent starts reasoning.
svg.desc: Reported observations: a large MCP setup used 143 thousand tokens, about 40 MCP tools used 55 thousand, ten JSON schemas are estimated at up to 14 thousand, and skill metadata uses about 100 tokens because full instructions load only when the skill is active.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
